correctness.rationale: Dirichlet beta neutrality gives an exact tail integral. Strict convexity and endpoint signs produce at most one interior zero; symmetric strict initial negativity follows from the increasing gamma ratio for q>1. The q=2 covariance is verified by differentiating an explicit beta-density expression and its zero endpoint. All dimensions m>=2, real q>1, and positive real parameters are treated. An independent rational-tail script passed 888 comparisons; finite checks supplement rather than replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: Exceedance count and Renyi/Simpson concentration are natural distinct diagnostics of mass fragmentation. The theorem gives a complete continuous threshold-dependence classification for all real powers, a sharp broken-stick threshold 2/(m+2) with nonzero critical-scale covariance, and an exact heterogeneity boundary eliminating the switch. These are structural phase distinctions, not arbitrary isolated numerical values.
